title: CXL 記憶體分層：依存取比例計算延遲預算
titleEn: CXL memory tiers: access-weighted latency budgeting
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體政策、配置粒度與 RAS 證據
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory policy, allocation granularity and RAS evidence
summary: 輸入 access_id、tier 與依賴鏈，另列 capacity_by_tier；禁止用容量表直接填入存取權重。
summaryEn: Build an access_id, tier and dependency-chain trace, with a separate capacity-by-tier table. Require access weights to come from the trace rather than copying capacity percentages into the latency formula.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 觀察延遲增加可能是熱資料分層錯置，也可能是負載形成排隊，使固定延遲假設失效；比較每層存取數、服務時間分布與併行度；若服務時間隨負載變動，另外建排隊模型。
教學平均預算 120 ns；名義通過、變更不通過。報告必須附無重疊假設，不能推廣成所有 CXL 工作負載結論。
CXL 裝置可呈現不同記憶體介面；本課固定 System RAM 情境，用存取比例而非容量比例估算序列依賴負載的延遲。
optionsEn: Increased observed latency may indicate hot-data misplacement or queueing that invalidates the constant-service assumption. A weighted mean cannot distinguish the two without per-tier timing and load evidence. Compare tier access counts, service-time distributions and concurrency. If per-tier service time changes with load, document the violated assumption and build a queueing model rather than retuning weights to fit.
Apply a 120 ns teaching mean-latency budget. Nominal placement passes and changed placement fails, with the no-overlap assumption attached; the result is not a general verdict on CXL workloads.

CXL devices can be exposed through different memory interfaces. Fix a System RAM teaching scenario and estimate serial dependent-access latency using access fractions, not the fraction of installed capacity in each tier.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。CXL 裝置可呈現不同記憶體介面；本課固定 System RAM 情境，用存取比例而非容量比例估算序列依賴負載的延遲。 與本階段判準一起判讀：以一百筆存取逐項相加再除以一百，核對 110 與 140；全本地與全擴充端點應為 80、200；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. CXL devices can be exposed through different memory interfaces. Fix a System RAM teaching scenario and estimate serial dependent-access latency using access fractions, not the fraction of installed capacity in each tier. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Independently sum one hundred trace entries and divide by one hundred. Verify 110 and 140, plus endpoint cases of 80 and 200 for entirely local or entirely extension-tier accesses. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。觀察延遲增加可能是熱資料分層錯置，也可能是負載形成排隊，使固定延遲假設失效；比較每層存取數、服務時間分布與併行度；若服務時間隨負載變動，另外建排隊模型。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Increased observed latency may indicate hot-data misplacement or queueing that invalidates the constant-service assumption. A weighted mean cannot distinguish the two without per-tier timing and load evidence. Compare tier access counts, service-time distributions and concurrency. If per-tier service time changes with load, document the violated assumption and build a queueing model rather than retuning weights to fit.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 以一百筆存取逐項相加再除以一百，核對 110 與 140；全本地與全擴充端點應為 80、200；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Independently sum one hundred trace entries and divide by one hundred. Verify 110 and 140, plus endpoint cases of 80 and 200 for entirely local or entirely extension-tier accesses. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.textEn: CXL devices can be exposed through different memory interfaces. Fix a System RAM teaching scenario and estimate serial dependent-access latency using access fractions, not the fraction of installed capacity in each tier.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 兩層平均服務延遲為 local_fraction*local_latency 加 remote_fraction*remote_latency；只適用此無重疊、無排隊模型。
knowledge.textEn: Weighted mean service latency sums access fraction times latency for each tier. The model assumes serial dependence, no overlap and no queueing; it is not a bandwidth or application-runtime model.

steps.objective: 完成「CXL 記憶體分層：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for CXL memory tiers: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付逐存取軌跡、容量與熱度兩表、端點測試與模型不適用的排隊案例。
在交接件中加入「CXL 記憶體分層：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：以一百筆存取逐項相加再除以一百，核對 110 與 140；全本地與全擴充端點應為 80、200；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：輸入 access_id、tier 與依賴鏈，另列 capacity_by_tier；禁止用容量表直接填入存取權重。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the access trace, separate capacity and hotness tables, endpoint tests and a queueing counterexample. Explain which additional measurements are needed before selecting a real placement policy.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for CXL memory tiers: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Independently sum one hundred trace entries and divide by one hundred. Verify 110 and 140, plus endpoint cases of 80 and 200 for entirely local or entirely extension-tier accesses. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build an access_id, tier and dependency-chain trace, with a separate capacity-by-tier table. Require access weights to come from the trace rather than copying capacity percentages into the latency formula. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。以一百筆存取逐項相加再除以一百，核對 110 與 140；全本地與全擴充端點應為 80、200；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Independently sum one hundred trace entries and divide by one hundred. Verify 110 and 140, plus endpoint cases of 80 and 200 for entirely local or entirely extension-tier accesses. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Independently sum one hundred trace entries and divide by one hundred. Verify 110 and 140, plus endpoint cases of 80 and 200 for entirely local or entirely extension-tier accesses. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
